title: Global well-posedness of non-integrable hyperbolic-ellptic Ishimori system in the critical Sobolev space
summary: We consider the Cauchy problem for the hyperbolic-elliptic Ishimori system with general decoupling constant $κ\in \mathbb{R}$ and prove global well-posedness in the critical Sobolev space. The proof relies primarily on new bilinear estimates, which are established via a novel div-curl lemma first introduced by the second author in \cite{zhou_1+2dimensional_2022}. Our approach combines the caloric gauge technique with $U^p$-$V^p$ type Strichartz estimates to handle the hyperbolic structure of the equation.
